# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# paper plots
We will now make plots for a draft paper. Make a new cpp and runner script in Plots/20260213_Central/plot_paper.cpp and plot-paper.sh and use the plotter script at Plots/20260213_Central/plot_central_combined.cpp as a starting point. These plots will contain the same EXACT information at the result plots in the overleaf (same central values for pPb and pp, same systematics) made from plot_central_combined, but will be of updated formatting. For new plotting functions, add and use new functions to KylesPlotting.h so as to not break compatibility with the current helper functions. Make plots with the following instructions:
 - pdf file 1: deltaphi result in bin (Zpt 0-500, trkpt 0.5-15), single plot. For now carry-over the same plotting done as the Zpt0-500, trk 0.5-15 result used in the analysis but double x and y axis labels, change the "CMS Preliminary" text to just "CMS" in bold, and change the system label in the top right to "pPb (pp) 8.16 TeV 174 nb^{-1} (301 pb^{-1})". Keep the pp,pPb,powheg labels and kinematic selection labels as they are.
 - pdf file 2: deltaETA result in bin (Zpt 0-500, trkpt 0.5-15), single plot. For now carry-over the same plotting done as the Zpt0-500, trk 0.5-15 result used in the analysis but double x and y axis labels, change the "CMS Preliminary" text to just "CMS" in bold, and change the system label in the top right to "pPb (pp) 8.16 TeV 174 nb^{-1} (301 pb^{-1})". Keep the pp,pPb,powheg labels and kinematic selection labels as they are.
 - pdf file 3: deltaphi scan plots made in a 2x3 grid (2 down 3 across) with Zpt 0-30 on the top row, Zpt 30-500 on the bottom row, and going left to right through trk pT 0.5-2, 2-4, 4-10. Keep the pp,pPb,powheg and kinematic labels in the plots as is done already. The plots should be draw with MINIMAL spacing between canvases. The top row should not have xaxis label and should be snug against the top of the second row, only the second row should have xaxis labels and double the current x axis label size. Change the "CMS Preliminary" text to just "CMS" in bold, and change the system label in the top right to "pPb (pp) 8.16 TeV 174 nb^{-1} (301 pb^{-1}) - these labels should only be on the first row of course since . Use the plot at Plots/20260213_Central/example.png for an example (save for that we have 2 rows instead of 3). In addition KEEP the difference plot pPb-pp as a lower figure for EACH of the 6 plots. Since each of these difference plots will be scalled differently we need nonzero lateral space between the plots, so have just enought that the plot labels are visible, but keep the y axis label just with the first plot in the row and remove it for the others so minimal white space is necessary. Use the same exact x and y ranges for the current overleaf result plots.
 - pdf file 4: same instructions as file 3 but for deltaeta results.
Dont push the pdfs to overleaf, just return with the path they were made at.

# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
